== Template:Item/CharmScaling ==

Displays charm scaling modifiers. Only shows scaling types that are provided.

=== Parameters ===

All parameters are optional.

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Description
|-
| '''strscaling''' || Strength scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''endscaling''' || Endurance scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''dexscaling''' || Dexterity scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''agiscaling''' || Agility scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''intscaling''' || Intelligence scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''wisscaling''' || Wisdom scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''chascaling''' || Charisma scaling modifier (0-40)
|-
| '''resistscaling''' || Resist scaling modifier (0-40, no + sign)
|-
| '''mitigationscaling''' || Mitigation scaling modifier (shown as %)
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/CharmScaling
|strscaling=5
|endscaling=3
|intscaling=10
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/CharmScaling
|strscaling=5
|endscaling=3
|intscaling=10
}}

----
